assets.treatment: Live text in utility red; no logo bitmap.
Consistent outline strokes; retain visible link labels and accessible button names. Hide redundant decorative SVGs from assistive technology.
White surfaces, fine gray rules, restrained neutral lesson fills, utility-red active navigation and CSS status dots. Status meaning must also remain available in real text.
Readable workhorse UI type; no remote font or rasterized text required.
Preserve native images, links, uploads, forms, timetable geometry and event handlers. Do not copy academic data or personal images into extension assets.

semanticRequirements: Render all navigation, headings, timetable data, lists, tables and controls as semantic code or preserved source DOM. The approved comp is a visual reference only and must not ship as interface content.
privacy: This inventory contains no student records, names, messages, grades, credentials or session data.
